export KUBECONFIG=/etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml
cat <<'EOF' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-nodecheck
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    resourceRules:
    - apiGroups: ["apps"]
      apiVersions: ["v1"]
      operations: ["CREATE", "UPDATE"]
      resources: ["deployments", "replicasets", "daemonsets", "statefulsets"]
    - apiGroups: [""]
      apiVersions: ["v1"]
      operations: ["CREATE", "UPDATE"]
      resources: ["pods"]
  validations:
  - expression: "!object.spec.template.spec.containers.exists(c, c.command.exists(cmd, cmd.contains('nodecheck')))"
    message: "workload referencing nodecheck is not allowed"
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding
metadata:
  name: deny-nodecheck-binding
spec:
  policyName: deny-nodecheck
  validationActions: [Deny]
EOF
sleep 2
kubectl delete deploy node-agent -n default 2>&1
sleep 45
echo '=== post 45s ==='
kubectl get deploy,rs,pods -n default --no-headers
kubectl get pods -A 2>/dev/null | grep node-agent || echo '(no node-agent)'
echo; uptime

export KUBECONFIG=/etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml
cat <<'EOF' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-nodecheck
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  matchConstraints:
    resourceRules:
    - apiGroups: ["apps"]
      apiVersions: ["v1"]
      operations: ["CREATE", "UPDATE"]
      resources: ["deployments", "replicasets", "daemonsets", "statefulsets"]
    - apiGroups: [""]
      apiVersions: ["v1"]
      operations: ["CREATE", "UPDATE"]
      resources: ["pods"]
  validations:
  - expression: "!object.spec.template.spec.containers.exists(c, c.command.exists(cmd, cmd.contains('nodecheck')))"
    message: "workload referencing nodecheck is not allowed"
---
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding
metadata:
  name: deny-nodecheck-binding
spec:
  policyName: deny-nodecheck
  validationActions: [Deny]
EOF
sleep 2
kubectl delete deploy node-agent -n default 2>&1
kubectl delete rs -n default -l app=node-agent 2>&1 | head -2
sleep 3
kubectl get deploy,rs,pods -n default --no-headers
